channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Na ONU, Lula recupera o controle da agenda
item.description: President Lula spoke at the UN General Assembly criticizing the global crisis and highlighting the importance of multilateral diplomacy, reaffirming Brazil's role on the international agenda. His speech comes with less than two weeks before the first round of elections, reinforcing his position of global leadership during the electoral period. The speech addressed issues such as inequality, sustainability and international cooperation.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado estadual no Rio de Janeiro (RJ): veja lista e números para votar
item.description: The 2026 elections in Rio de Janeiro will contest state deputy seats, with the list published by the TSE. Voters should check the ballot name, number, party, and electoral court registration status before voting. Official information is available on the Electoral Candidates and Accounts disclosure portal.

item.title: Candidatos a deputado federal em São Paulo (SP): veja lista e números para votar
item.description: The list of candidates for federal deputy in São Paulo (SP) for the 2026 elections is available on the TSE website, including campaign name, number, party, and registry status with the Electoral Court. Voters can access updated information directly through the official Tribunal Superior Eleitoral portal.

item.title: Após suspeitas sobre voto de Nunes Marques, Gilmar tenta levar ao plenário caso de usinas
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes proposed an order question to bring to the plenary a case regarding compensation to sugar-alcohol plants, following divergent interpretations of theme 826 at the STF. The case became controversial after leaked messages suggested political favoritism in Minister Nunes Marques' vote, who was praised by lawyers linked to billion-dollar interests. Gilmar argues for the need to uniform the Court's understanding on the requirement of individual expertise to recognize the State's civil liability.

item.title: Flávio aciona TSE contra Lula por evento com promessa de canetas emagrecedoras
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a lawsuit with the TSE against Lula, Alckmin and ministers for alleged electoral propaganda in official events. Representation questions use of government channels to promote promises, such as weight-loss pens via SUS. Action consolidates 14th formal accusation by Flávio against the PT candidate.

item.title: Maioria dos eleitores rejeita Gilmar, Fachin, Kassio, Moraes e Toffoli
item.description: A 2026 AtlasIntel/Estadão survey shows most voters reject Supreme Court justices such as Toffoli, Kassio, Fachin, Gilmar, and Moraes, while André Mendonça and Cármen Lúcia receive the highest approval. Conducted during a crisis at the STF, the poll reveals that 61% of respondents do not trust the Court, up nearly 10 percentage points from 2025.

item.title: O estado em que Lula tem quase o dobro de votos de Flávio Bolsonaro, segundo pesquisa
item.description: An AtlasIntel survey shows President Lula leading with 58.3% of voting intentions in Pernambuco, nearly triple Flávio Bolsonaro's 29.9%. Government approval for Lula in the state stands at 59%, according to the poll with a two-point margin of error.

item.title: Na farra das promoções, ex-chefe da PCRJ promoveu delegado morto há 12 anos
item.description: Amid the wave of merit promotions under Felipe Curi, former head of the Rio de Janeiro Civil Police and pre-candidate for the Chamber of Deputies by the PP, a police delegate who died in 2014 was posthumously promoted. Between 2024 and 2026, Curi granted 1,095 merit promotions, including one to himself, far exceeding his predecessors. The promotion of a delegate deceased for 12 years and the secrecy surrounding the process raise concerns about transparency and criteria used in the promotions.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro é internada por crise de enxaqueca e segue sem previsão de alta
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, former first lady and Senate candidate from the Federal District (PL), was hospitalized in Brasília due to an acute migraine with no expected discharge date, affecting her campaign. This is the second hospitalization related to headaches in less than a month.

item.title: Tarcísio promete universalizar saneamento básico em 371 municípios até 2029 com R$ 70 bilhões em investimentos
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas promised to universalize basic sanitation in 371 municipalities served by Sabesp by 2029, with R$ 70 billion in investments. The goal, included in the company's contract, involves a 40.6% increase in wastewater treatment capacity, benefiting over 4 million people.

item.title: Avaliação negativa de Mendonça e Nunes Marques cresce, diz AtlasIntel
item.description: AtlasIntel/Estadão survey shows rise in negative image of STF ministers André Mendonça and Kassio Nunes Marques, both appointed by Jair Bolsonaro. Mendonça's negative rating grew from 36% to 48%, with Nunes Marques leading the rejection increase.

item.title: Flávio aciona TSE contra Lula por suposto uso eleitoral da máquina pública
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Alfredo Gaspar filed a lawsuit with the TSE accusing Lula of using the public machine for electoral purposes during official visits to Eurofarma and the PRF. The campaign questions the politicization of institutional events and their dissemination through government channels. This is the 14th representation filed against the PT candidate in five months.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro é internada 'sem previsão de alta' em Brasília por conta de quadro de enxaqueca
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) was hospitalized at Hospital DF Star in Brasília due to a severe migraine unresponsive to outpatient treatment, with no discharge forecast yet. In August, she was already admitted to the same facility for an anesthetic block due to persistent headaches, shortly before the official start of election campaigns.

item.title: Gilmar propõe levar caso de usinas ao plenário após mensagens de Vorcaro mostrarem interesse em voto de Nunes Marques
item.description: Minister Gilmar Mendes proposed taking a case to the STF plenary regarding compensation for sugarcane ethanol plants, following messages from Vorcaro suggesting interest in a vote by Nunes Marques. The discussion involves the need for individual expertise to prove damages in cases where compensation criteria are already set. The case gained attention after investigations revealed contracts between Banco Master and an office linked to Newton Ramos.

item.title: Lula lidera com folga entre os eleitores de Pernambuco, diz pesquisa AtlasIntel
item.description: A new AtlasIntel poll shows President Lula (PT) leading by a significant margin among Pernambuco voters, with 60.1% in the first round and 60.5% in the second round against 32.7% for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The survey was conducted between September 15th and 20th with 1,836 interviews and has a two-point margin of error.

item.title: 'Ícone', condolências e vídeo com Jair: presidenciáveis repercutem a morte do sertanejo Rick em acidente aéreo
item.description: The death of singer Rick in an airplane crash prompted reactions from several presidential candidates, including Flávio Bolsonaro, Augusto Cury, and Romeu Zema, who shared condolence messages and solidarity. Flávio posted a video featuring Jair Bolsonaro singing a song by the late artist.

item.title: Atlas: Raquel Lyra tem 48,6% das intenções de voto para o governo de PE; João Campos soma 47,4%
item.description: AtlasIntel poll shows a technical tie between Raquel Lyra (PSD) and João Campos (PSB) for Pernambuco's governorship, with 48.6% and 47.4% respectively. In a potential runoff, Lyra leads slightly at 49.2% versus Campos' 48.5%, while Lula dominates the presidential race in the state with 58.3% of voting intentions.

item.title: TRE-RJ libera candidatura de Rueda à Câmara após parecer contrário do MPE
item.description: The TRE-RJ approved, by unanimous decision, the candidacy of Antônio Rueda (União Brasil) for the Chamber of Deputies after reviewing allegations of ties to militias in Baixada Fluminense. The rapporteur concluded there is no concrete evidence that the candidate benefited from a paramilitary structure, dismissing direct links with Eduardo Araújo and Fabinho Varandão. The MPE also changed its stance, recommending rejection, but the court ruled in favor of the candidate.

item.title: Flávio diz que Dino faz perseguição no STF em apuração sobre emendas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro accused Minister Flávio Dino of political persecution in the investigation into parliamentary amendments, highlighting the funding case for the film Dark Horse. He also criticized the STF for allegedly interfering in elections and claimed he would rebuild Brazilian democracy.

item.title: Ao vivo: Edinho, Alckmin e Haddad participam de ato em São Paulo
item.description: Vice-president Geraldo Alckmin (PSB), PT national president Edinho Silva, and former Finance Minister Fernando Haddad (PT), candidate for São Paulo governor, take part in the political event “O Brasil Pronto Para Mais” in São Paulo. The gathering brings together candidates and members of parties allied to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), amid the 2026 elections.

item.title: Ao vivo: TSE lança campanha de combate à violência contra a mulher
item.description: The TSE launched a campaign against political violence towards women with the event 'Political Violence HAS GENDER' in Brasília. Initiatives were presented such as a joint action protocol, training for judges, a public data panel and the Likeness ID tool to detect deepfakes on YouTube. The campaign 'Politics IS a Feminine Noun' was also launched to raise awareness about electoral violence against women.

item.title: Vamos entrar com potência' na campanha de 2º turno de Flávio Bolsonaro, diz Tarcísio
item.description: São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, running for re-election, said he is preparing to campaign with 'great strength' in support of Flávio Bolsonaro in a potential presidential runoff, highlighting their political alliance.

item.title: Trump diz na ONU que regime de Cuba “vai cair” e delegação se retira
item.description: At the UN General Assembly, Donald Trump stated that Cuba's communist regime 'will fall', prompting the Cuban delegation to leave the session. Trump intensified sanctions against the island, worsening its energy and economic crisis, while highlighting threats from cartels in Latin America and potential deals with Iran. The situation in Cuba is exacerbated by the embargo and reliance on alternative energy sources.

item.title: Na ONU, Lula critica ação dos EUA na região: 'Brasil não cabe no quintal de ninguém'
item.description: At the 81st UN General Assembly, Lula criticized U.S. interference in Latin America, stating Brazil does not belong in anyone's backyard. He emphasized the need for partnerships with positive agendas and stressed the importance of regional integration despite ideological differences.

item.title: O outro sujeito oculto do discurso de Lula na Assembleia Geral da ONU além de Donald Trump
item.description: Beyond Donald Trump, who was not named, Lula's speech at the 81st UN General Assembly had another hidden figure: Ricardo Magro, owner of Grupo Refit. The president criticized neocolonialism and U.S. interference in Latin American electoral processes.

item.title: Lula na ONU — discurso na Assembleia Geral começa em instantes; Trump fala depois
item.description: The live coverage of Lula and Trump's speeches at the UN has been concluded. Lula spoke first, followed by Trump. The broadcast thanked viewers who followed the coverage.

item.title: Lula e comitiva chegam à Assembleia Geral da ONU; brasileiro será primeiro líder a discursar
item.description: Lula and his delegation arrived at the UN General Assembly, where Brazil will be the first leader to speak at the opening session. The moment reinforces Brazil's relevance on the global agenda and may spark debates on foreign policy and international cooperation. Expectations are high that the speech will address sustainable development and UN system reform.

item.title: Real Time: Lula vence Flávio Bolsonaro com folga entre eleitores de Sergipe
item.description: A poll released on September 22 shows President Lula (PT) leading with 58% of first-round voting intentions in Sergipe, surpassing Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) by 32 points. In the projected runoff, Lula would maintain a 34-point lead over Flávio. The Real Time Big Data poll interviewed 1,600 voters between September 17 and 21, with a margin of error of two percentage points.

item.title: Juíza pede que a AGU explique o motivo de representar Janja judicialmente
item.description: Judge Maria Cecília de Marco Rocha ordered the AGU to explain its judicial representation of First Lady Janja da Silva in a lawsuit challenging the use of public funds for her international trips. The AGU must provide proof that Janja requested representation and the legal opinion that supported it. The suit, filed by Guilherme Kilter and Jeffrey Chiquini, alleges irregular public funding of the First Lady's travels, whose request for suspension was denied.

item.title: Crusoé: Desistência de Bachelet é mais novo fiasco da diplomacia petista
item.description: Former Chilean president Michelle Bachelet withdrew her candidacy for UN Secretary-General after receiving only 1 favorable vote and 11 against in the informal Security Council vote. Despite support from President Lula, her candidacy was rejected, marking another diplomatic setback for the Petista administration.

item.title: Guterres abre Assembleia Geral da ONU; Lula discursa em seguida
item.description: Lula spoke at the opening of the 81st UN General Assembly, emphasizing multilateralism and warning about potential foreign interference in Brazilian elections, particularly regarding Marco Rubio and Donald Trump.

item.title: O bombardeio de André Mendonça contra Alexandre de Moraes na guerra do STF
item.description: Minister André Mendonça accused Alexandre de Moraes of using the Federal Police and the Fake News Inquiry to interfere in investigations, involving alleged irregularities in the minister's conduct. The crisis at the STF deepened with mutual accusations between the justices.

item.title: AO VIVO: acompanhe a Assembleia Geral da ONU em NY
item.description: The UN General Assembly in New York features speeches by Lula and Trump amid criticism of multilateralism and budget cuts. Lula advocates sovereignty and cooperation, while Trump attacks the UN, deepening tensions. The institution faces a credibility and existential crisis.

item.title: O ressentimento vai às urnas (por Marcos Magalhães)
item.description: The text analyzes how social resentment, fueled by inequalities and economic crises, influences voters in Brazil and abroad. It shows how radical right-wing discourse exploits the dissatisfaction of workers against social policies and migrants, with emphasis on Trump's case in the US. The author warns about the dangerous normalization of hatred and xenophobia as an electoral strategy.

item.title: Crusoé: Imperador Lula tenta interferir na eleição dos EUA
item.description: President Lula criticized Trump at the UN, accusing him of acting like an emperor, but the criticisms could reflect on himself, according to the article. The trip was for the UN General Assembly.

item.title: Entenda diferença de metodologia nas principais pesquisas eleitorais
item.description: The main Brazilian electoral polls mainly differ in data collection methodology: street interviews, phone calls, or online surveys. This variation can impact the results and reliability of the polls.

item.title: JOTA Principal | Reta final do 1º turno tem distância curta entre Lula e Flávio e novos vazamentos no STF
item.description: New leaks from Daniel Vorcaro's phone suggest payments to 'Turma do KN', linked to Justice Kassio Nunes Marques, deepening tensions at the STF. The race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro remains tight, with PT stressing Flávio as the candidate of the wealthy. The atmosphere of division in the Court and allegations of bias involving André Mendonça worsen the electoral scenario.

item.title: Mendonça rebate Moraes e pede arquivamento de investigação
item.description: Minister André Mendonça responded to accusations from Alexandre de Moraes, requesting the case be archived and challenging the use of Federal Police intelligence reports. The matter involves allegations of abuse of authority and political favoritism, now pending review at the Supreme Federal Court.

item.title: Lula discursa na Assembleia Geral da ONU; acompanhe ao vivo
item.description: Lula spoke at the UN reaffirming Brazil's sovereignty and warning against foreign interference in elections, maintaining a restrained tone without direct attacks. The speech reinforced the defense of multilateralism and democracy, themes present since his first participation in the organization.

item.title: Crusoé: Flávio alerta contra “mais quatro Alexandres de Moraes” no STF
item.description: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) warned against the possibility of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) appointing new ministers deemed critical, such as 'four more Alexandres de Moraes' or 'four Flávios Dinos', should he be reelected as President of the Republic. He criticized the current government, alleging that the country is at risk due to the president's supposed abandonment of the Brazilian people.

item.title: Mendonça pede arquivamento de denúncia contra ele e sugere que Moraes deveria ser investigado
item.description: Minister André Mendonça requested the dismissal of a complaint filed by Alexandre de Moraes, denying any irregularities. Mendonça suggested that Morae should be investigated for his actions at the STF.

item.title: Quem é Bruno Avelar, empresário que embarcou em helicóptero com Rick
item.description: Brazilian businessman Bruno Avelar, 41, is among the four passengers of a helicopter that vanished on Monday afternoon, 21, during a flight from Porto Belo to São Joaquim in Santa Catarina. The aircraft lost communication and search operations are being led by the Fire Department and the Brazilian Air Force. Avelar, an influencer with over 650,000 followers, founded the O Poder do Network project and serves as an advisor to Augusto Cury's 2026 presidential campaign.

item.title: Os brasileiros que não são obrigados a votar nas eleições de 2026
item.description: In the 2026 Brazilian elections, over 158.7 million people are eligible to vote, but voting is optional for three groups: 16- and 17-year-olds, illiterate individuals, and voters over 70. For these groups, voting is a right rather than an obligation, unlike citizens aged 18 to 70. The aging population has increased the share of voters aged 60 or older, now accounting for 23.60% of the national electorate.

item.title: Protesto em Nova York projeta Flávio Bolsonaro entregando faixa presidencial a Trump
item.description: Protesters in New York projected fake images of Jair Bolsonaro handing over the presidential sash to Donald Trump before the 81st UN General Assembly session. The action took place on Tuesday morning, hours before the opening speech.

item.title: Mendonça pede a Fachin que Moraes seja investigado por abuso de autoridade no STF
item.description: Justice André Mendonça requested the Supreme Court to investigate Alexandre de Moraes for allegedly using the Federal Police illegally to target fellow justices, including himself, within the Fake News inquiry. Fachin, then president of the Court, removed Moraes from the case following the motion.

item.title: Ratinho Junior abandona Caiado no Paraná e tenta colar em Flávio
item.description: The governor of Paraná, Ratinho Junior, criticized Sergio Moro and indirectly endorsed Flávio Bolsonaro, questioning Moro's alleged connections with former president Jair Bolsonaro. He highlighted Sandro Alex as the most Bolsonarist-aligned candidate and claimed Moro betrayed Bolsonaro during the pandemic. Ratinho chose to stay in state government to support succession, sidestepping Ronaldo Caiado in the PSD presidential race.

item.title: Lula amplia guerra digital contra Flávio Bolsonaro e tenta virar jogo das redes
item.description: Lula expanded his digital strategy to compete with Flávio Bolsonaro on social media, using new content formats and legal actions. The PT campaign requested an investigation into the use of 'collabs' on Instagram by Flávio's team, alleging amplification of electoral content. Recent data shows increased engagement on Lula's profile, indicating a shift in the campaign's digital approach.

item.title: Lula defende 'soberania' e e relembra discursos anteriores em postagem horas antes de discurso na Assembleia da ONU
item.description: Lula used a social media post to recall the central themes of his previous UN speeches, such as fighting hunger, defending multilateralism and Brazilian sovereignty, hours before his General Assembly address. The post reinforced his social agenda and international governance reform.

item.title: Lula deve dar recados a Trump em discurso na ONU nesta terça
item.description: President Lula will speak at the 81st UN General Assembly in New York, emphasizing multilateralism and criticizing Donald Trump's policies, particularly the trade war and alleged interference in Brazilian elections. He will use the platform to counter Flávio Bolsonaro and address issues such as national sovereignty, UN Security Council reform, environment, and natural resource exploitation.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta terça-feira (22)
item.description: On Tuesday (22), presidential candidates carry out campaign agendas with walks, caravans, events, interviews, debates, and community gatherings. Augusto Cury, Clariana Barão, Edmilson Costa, Flávio Bolsonaro, Hertz Dias, Lula, Renan Santos, Zema, Caiado, and Wilson Grassi have public activities scheduled, while Samara Martins, Leonardo Avalanche, and Rui Costa Pimenta have no disclosed or public agenda. The main focus is electoral mobilization and voter engagement across various regions.
